Subject: ChronoHealth: renewal uplift coordination, QBR time options & SOW next steps

Hi Emma / Chrono procurement team —

Thanks again for the call last week. Per our discussion, I want to get a short renewal & expansion cadence started so we have clear owners, a QBR date, and an agreed path for the additional capacity you asked about (burst GPUs + higher token throughput).

Proposed immediate next steps: 
- Confirm QBR (60m) week of June 14 — see 3 time blocks below.
- Review the attached QBR agenda and the SOW draft I attached (SOW includes the uplift to 2x reserved capacity and a staged 6-month price floor).
- Procurement: if you can share PO lead / legal reviewer, we’ll get a redline-friendly copy over.

Time options (please pick one):
- Tue Jun 15, 10:00–11:00 PT
- Wed Jun 16, 13:00–14:00 PT
- Thu Jun 17, 08:30–09:30 PT

If none of those work, propose a couple alternatives and I’ll coordinate. Internal owners: Monica will lead technical runbook review, Ben will own commercial/discounting discussion, I’ll manage the timeline and legal handoff.

Attachments: [chrono_qbr_agenda_v1.pdf (PDF)], [chrono_sow_draft_v1.docx (DOCX)]

Thanks — looking forward to aligning.

—
Nikhil Sharma
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
nikhil.sharma@redwood.com

Hi Nikhil —

Thanks for the note and the docs. Appreciate the clarity. Quick answers:
- We can do Wed Jun 16, 13:00 PT.
- I’ve looped in Procurement (procurement@chronohealth.com) and Legal; Sarah (legal) will be the primary reviewer.
- We need the SOW to call out a 12-month minimum term for the uplift and a staged billing schedule (monthly). Can your draft reflect that?

One question on capacity: the 2x reserved capacity in the SOW — can you confirm whether that includes burst headroom during month-end batch jobs, or is that separate add-on? We have heavy inference loads on the 1st and 15th.

Will confirm the attendee list for our side by EOD Wednesday.

Best,

ChronoHealth

Subject: Re: ChronoHealth: renewal uplift coordination, QBR time options & SOW next steps

Thanks — following up on a couple technical points before the QBR so we’re ready to present: 

- Burst capacity: we can include a monthly burst pool (pay-as-you-go) that is gated by budget alerts. For the SOW I can add an appendix that defines burst thresholds (e.g., 4x baseline for up to 6 hours/day).
- KV cache sizing: to keep latency for your 2k-token inference at <150ms p95 we recommend a 48GB KV cache profile — I’ll include this recommendation in the tech appendix.

Ben / Nikhil: can one of you confirm whether we should include a one-time onboarding credit (we previously discussed a $10k onboarding discount) in the SOW or hold it as a commercial note for the QBR? Emma, happy to put both options in the SOW and mark one as tentative.

—
Monica
Head of Solutions, Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>

Cc: procurement@chronohealth.com
Date: Wed, 27 May 2026 15:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: ChronoHealth: renewal uplift coordination, QBR time options & SOW next steps

Emma — great to hear Wed the 16th works. We’ll plan the commercial section accordingly. A couple quick clarifications ahead of the QBR: 

- Term & billing: we can structure the uplift on a 12-month minimum term as requested; billing monthly with an invoiced monthly summary. I will add two pricing rows in the SOW: (1) committed reserved capacity 2x at $X/month, (2) burst pool on usage at $Y/token.
- Onboarding credit: we recommend applying the $10k credit to the first invoice rather than a list price reduction so it’s easier to track. If you prefer a permanent percent discount let us know.
- Legal redlines: once Sarah on legal sends markups, we’ll push to get a clean signed SOW within 10 business days of final redline.

I’ll attach an updated commercial appendix before the QBR.

Best,
Ben Carter
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference

- Please include a short demo of live latency under the proposed KV cache profile and a plan for how Redwood will handle spike days.

Sarah (legal) — we’ll circulate our initial redlines within 48 hours. Procurement will coordinate PO timing.

See you on the 16th.
